name: Patterns in Software Engineering
description:
- Patterns as approach to structure and describe expert knowledge 
- Pattern-based software development 
- Categories of Patterns: 
  - Architectural Patterns 
  - design Patterns 
  - Analysis Patterns 
  - Process Patterns 
  - project management Patterns 
  - Classification and Combination of Patterns 
- Using Patterns: 
  - in Analysis 
  - in design 
  - in existing models and legacy systems
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Introduction to Software Engineering (Module IN0006)
